record.title: Designer, landscaper or gardener: who do you need?
record.why: The site's pages close on "Not sure which you need?", but nothing on the Services page or in the journal helps a reader at the choosing stage tell these trades apart or understand where the studio fits.
record.notes: Open on a line people say, something like "We just need someone to sort the garden out." Then set out plainly what a designer does, what a landscaping contractor does and what a maintenance gardener does, and where the jobs overlap. Be straight about when the reader doesn't need a designer at all, because that honesty is in keeping with the voice. [Need from the studio: which of these it does in-house and who it works alongside, so nothing is invented.]
